title: PardoGarcia2026: Mu/beta motor-imagery EEG in chronic MCA stroke and healthy controls
description: Pre-execution, two-class hand motor-imagery EEG (precision pinch vs closed fist) recorded with 63 BrainVision channels at 1000 Hz. The dataset includes 10 chronic middle cerebral artery (MCA) stroke patients, recorded at baseline and after rehabilitation, and 8 healthy controls. It supports investigation of mu and beta oscillatory changes (event-related desynchronization) during motor preparation and imagery in stroke rehabilitation.
methods_description: Image-cued hand motor imagery and preparation (pinch vs fist) preceding a later auditory go cue and overt execution. EEG was recorded with a BrainVision system using 63 channels (59 EEG, 4 EOG) in a 10-10 montage at 1000 Hz, referenced to the right mastoid (A2). Only the pre-execution phase (0-1.5 s) is exposed. Patients were recorded before and after rehabilitation.
